title.en: Remove ambiguous duplicate Sprint reading choices
title.zh: 消除今日速成阅读题的重复歧义选项

purpose.en: Close the production reading defect found after v29: two choices could expose the same accessible label while only one hidden identifier was accepted.
purpose.zh: 修复 v29 后生产验收发现的阅读缺陷：两个选项可能显示相同的可访问文本，但只有一个隐藏标识会被判为正确。

en: Guarantee distinct visible and accessible labels for every Sprint reading choice.
Keep the correct option when repairing an older in-progress plan that already contains duplicate labels.
Prefer distractors generated from the current round's learned vocabulary before using same-level catalog fallback sentences.
zh: 保证每道今日速成阅读题的可见文本和可访问名称均不重复。
修复已有重复选项的进行中计划时保留真正的正确选项。
优先使用本轮已学词生成的句子作为干扰项，必要时才使用同级目录回退句。

en: Signed-in and anonymous Today's Sprint reading choices, including resumed signed-in plans; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, or unrelated learning behavior.
zh: 登录及匿名今日速成的阅读选项（包括恢复的登录计划）；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点或无关学习行为。

en: Normalize reading labels and deterministically collapse duplicates while preserving the answer identifier.
Build three unique choices from all current adaptive round sentences before consulting graded same-level fallback content.
Sanitize stored in-progress Sprint plans when they are resumed, so existing affected runs become usable without deleting progress.
zh: 规范化阅读选项文本，并在保留正确答案标识的前提下确定性合并重复项。
先从当前自适应学习轮次的全部句子构建三个唯一选项，再查询同级分级回退内容。
恢复进行中的今日速成计划时清理已保存的重复选项，无需删除学员进度。

en: Run the duplicate-choice regression contract, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.
Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, resume the affected ordinary test learner Sprint, and verify all visible reading choices are unique and the visible matching answer grades correctly.
zh: 执行重复选项回归合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare，恢复受影响普通测试学员的今日速成，并验证所有阅读选项文本唯一且匹配答案能正确判分。

en: The remaining en/ja/es/it real-learning matrix and observable normal-versus-slow audio timing require the fresh Terra production retest after this deployment.
zh: 剩余英/日/西/意真实学习矩阵及可观察的正常/慢速音频时长，需要在本次发布后由 Terra 重新执行生产验收。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
